annotations.title: Send feedback to the while team

description: Sends feedback to the while team (a bug, a gap, an idea) in the person's words, when they ask for it. while attaches who sends it, the organization, while's version and the last 5 failed calls of this identity (the tool and the code only); nothing else from the conversation is sent.

authentication.description: integration: how the service authenticates (API key, OAuth, OIDC federation, other).

block.description: block: the block (its id in catalog).

documentation.description: integration: the https address of its documentation.

kind.description: bug (while is wrong), frustration (the user's, in their words), idea, other, integration (a service to connect), block (a block to open).

message.description: What happens, what was expected; 4,000 characters at most.

organization.description: The organization; otherwise the project's or the token's.

reference.description: The identifier of an error, a call or an approval.

service.description: integration: the service to connect (Stripe, Snowflake, Anthropic…).

trial.description: The key returned by the first deploy_app (trial_key), passed again on each call.

usage.description: integration, block: what the app wants to do with it.

volume.description: block: the expected volume (sends per day, GiB…).

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback to the while team
